dct_title_s: Webster County, Iowa, 1939, aerial photomosaic index
dct_description_sm: Title supplied by cataloger based on information from sheet labels. Images are photoreductions of mosaics created from original aerial photographs. Designating symbol CAC. Form of individual image numbering: CAC-1-[number], CAC-2-[number], or CAC-3-[number]. Date of publication inferred from dates on individual photographs within mosaic. Flown by Aero Service Corp. Philidelphia, Pa. "Approximate scale, 1:20,000" [refers to individual images from which mosaic was made].
